stem:
Padma has two treasure numbers, $12$ and $18$. She may use only one jump size, repeated, and that jump size must land exactly on both treasures.

Which list gives every successful jump size?

options.text: The common multiples of $12$ and $18$, because reaching both is what produces the factor list.
$4$ and $9$, each of which hits only one of the two treasures.

teacher.key_rationale: A single jump size reaches both treasures exactly when it is a common factor of 12 and 18. Those factors are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
